doneWhen.text: The Ledger exposes its accounts and entries API as a #[rpc::service] (queries and mutations with idempotency keys, one server stream for statements) that calls the same handlers as its REST routes; REST and OpenAPI stay (ADR 0014: REST + OpenAPI remains the public API style).

Prod posture still clean with zero accepted risks; every procedure declared public or guarded (access-report snapshot updated).
